visual.general_description: Cardiotocography-style tracing with an upper black trace and a lower black trace on green graph paper and one arrow.
visual.detailed_description: Two-part tracing on green graph paper with a light-green shaded band. The upper plot has a black line and a thin pale pink line against a vertical axis printed 60 to 200 in steps of 20 on both the left and right edges. The black line sits mostly between about 150 and 175 on that axis with several short gaps, and between roughly one half and two thirds of the width it drops to about 110 to 145 with a gap and small dots, then returns to about 150 to 175. The pink line runs mostly near 100 to 130. One black upward-pointing arrow lies below the black line at the dip, near the middle of the image. The lower plot has a row of small blue bars across its top and a black line against an axis printed 0 to 100 in steps of 20: a rounded rise to about 80 near the left, a sharp spike to about 85 near the middle followed by a plateau around 50 to 60 that falls to about 10, and a smaller bump to about 28 near the right. No printed time labels, patient names, identifiers, dates, device text or panel letters are visible.

visual.general_description: Composite figure with a treatment timeline of drug and fluid labels above a chart of heart rate, blood pressure range bars and SpO2 against minutes after operating room arrival, with event arrows below.
visual.detailed_description: Composite figure. The upper part is a timeline of treatments with text labels: a bar labeled Bicarbonate Ringer’s solution with segments 500 mL and 700 mL; a bar labeled Insulin human with a thicker segment 2 U/h followed by a thinner segment 1 U/h; a bar labeled Glucose 4 g/h. Below are arrows labeled Bupivacaine 12 mg; Fentanyl 10 µg; Morphine 100 µg (intrathecal), Ephedrine 4 mg, a Phenylephrine bar with segments 2 mg/h, 3 mg/h and 1 mg/h, and Oxytocin with three arrows each labeled 5U. A box at the upper right lists: Total blood loss 295 mL; Total amniotic fluid 600 mL; Urine output 250 mL; Infusion volume 1,200 mL; Anesthesia time 92 min; Surgical time 59 min. The lower part is a chart with left axis labeled BP (mmHg) and HR (bpm) from 0 to 200 in steps of 40, a right axis labeled SpO2 (%) with ticks 96, 98 and 100, and a horizontal axis labeled Time after arrival in operating room (minutes) from 0 to 140 in steps of 20. Green circles (HR) lie roughly between 108 and 145, red vertical bars (BP) span from about 25 to 70 at the low end up to about 115 to 155 at the high end, and blue diamonds (SpO2) lie mostly at 98 with several slightly lower and one at about 96 near 40 minutes. A legend lists HR, BP and SpO2, and a key box defines HR, BP, SpO2, an upward triangle as operation start, a downward triangle as operation end, and LUD as left uterine displacement. Arrows below the horizontal axis are labeled Arrival in Operating Room at 0, Spinal anesthesia and LUD at about 35 to 37, Fetal delivery and Placental delivery at about 65 to 68, with an upward triangle near 55 and a downward triangle near 116. No patient names, identifiers, dates or device text are visible.
